title: jsc2020m000167_DM-2_Hatch_Open_200531
description: NEWLY ARRIVED NASA ASTRONAUTS ON SPACE STATION GREETED BY INTERNATIONAL SPACE STATION CREW  Within hours after docking to the International Space Station aboard their new SpaceX Crew Dragon craft “Endeavour” May 31, NASA astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken floated aboard the orbital outpost and were greeted by Expedition 63 Commander Chris Cassidy of NASA and Russian crewmates Anatoly Ivanishin and Ivan Vagner. Almost nine years after the retirement of the space shuttle, the launches of American astronauts on American spacecraft from American soil resumed with Hurley and Behnken launching on the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Space Center, Florida May 30.
keywords: SpaceX, DM-2, Crew Dragon, ISS, International Space Station, Expedition 63, Doug Hurley, Bob Bhenken, Chris Cassidy
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
